title: Sparkly pear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='pearBody' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d8f57a'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#a8d63a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5f9e1f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='pearGlow' cx='38%' cy='32%' r='45%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f2ffb8' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f2ffb8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- pear body: narrow top, round bottom -->
  <path d='M50 26
           C44 26 42 33 42 39
           C42 46 36 50 33 57
           C29 66 32 78 42 83
           C48 86 52 86 58 83
           C68 78 71 66 67 57
           C64 50 58 46 58 39
           C58 33 56 26 50 26 Z'
        fill='url(#pearBody)' stroke='#7fbf2a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <ellipse cx='45' cy='40' rx='7' ry='9' fill='url(#pearGlow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='66' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#eaffa8' opacity='0.45'/>

  <path d='M50 26 C50 20 52 16 55 13' fill='none' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M56 19 C61 18 66 19 69 21' fill='none' stroke='#2e7d22' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ff9f6e' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ff9f6e' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- sparkles around pear -->

    <circle cx='72' cy='44' r='1.8'/>

    <circle cx='75' cy='82' r='1.5'/>
